channel.description: Latest articles from Just A Pinch Recipes (justapinch.com)

item.title: Texas Tamale Balls
item.description: Now, these may look like your average meatball, but they sure don't taste like them. They are full of Tex-Mex flavor. Crushed Fritos not only serve as the binding agent but add the corn flavor that makes these smell and taste similar to tamales. The chili sauce is a nice complement and the flavor soaks into the meatballs while simmering in the slow cooker. If you need an appetizer, these are definitely different and everyone will keep coming back for more.

item.title: Baked Taco Dip
item.description: Warm, gooey, and cheesy, you won't be able to stop eating this baked taco dip. The refried beans and ground beef mixture has just the right amount of taco seasoning. A layer of sour cream mellows the flavors a little bit. There's an ample amount of melted cheddar cheese on top. Serve with corn chips or tortilla chips for a yummy game day snack or taco night appetizer.

item.title: Pank-Crusted Chicken Breast
item.description: An easy and delicious way to prepare chicken breasts. The coating is savory and full of flavor. Adding fresh thyme and lemon adds a freshness to it. The hints of citrus linger in every bite. Once fried, the crust is crisp and the chicken is tender and juicy.

item.title: Bacon Cheesburger Skillet
item.description: This bacon cheeseburger skillet is a homemade Hamburger Helper, but so much better. It's filled with hearty ground beef, smoky bacon, and onion. Rotel adds a little kick of flavor. Stirring in shredded cheddar cheese adds creaminess to the skillet meal. A great budget-friendly dinner idea that your entire family will love.

item.title: Happy Tummy Chicken & Noodles
item.description: Teena's chicken and noodle soup is comfort food at its finest. Whether you want something to help you get over a cold or just to warm you up, everyone will enjoy this soup. The noodles are the star. They taste homemade and are very tender (try to find them if you can). Carrots, celery, and onions are a staple in any good chicken soup. item.title: Mee Maw's Chocolate Cake
item.description: Vintage recipes are always fun to prepare, and this scratch-made chocolate cake recipe is one of them. Coffee enhances the chocolate flavor in this light and fluffy cake. Each bite melts in your mouth. Rich and creamy, the homemade chocolate frosting makes this a cake for chocolate lovers. There's just enough for a thin layer of frosting which is just the right amount because it's super rich. You'll find yourself making this old-fashioned chocolate cake often.

item.title: Blue Ribbon Blueberry Coffee Cake
item.description: Love blueberries and coffee cake? Then you have to try this recipe! The cake is not overly sweet. It's soft, tender, and melts in your mouth. There is the perfect amount of blueberries in the cake that you get one in each bite. Sugar sprinkled on top crisps in the baking process and adds a nice touch of sweetness.

item.title: Smothered Chicken with Rice
item.description: This smothered chicken with rice elevates the classic chicken and rice casserole recipe. The rice is mixed with creamy soup with big chunks of fresh mushrooms and a hint of garlic. When the chicken thighs are baked in the rice and sauce, they become tender and juicy, and the skin slightly crisps up. It's a wonderful chicken dinner.

item.title: Croissant Breakfast Sandwich Casserole
item.description: With crispy buttery croissants and smoky bacon, what is there not to love about this dish?! It bakes like a casserole but cuts into perfect individual sandwiches. The cheese is ooey gooey and the eggs cook up wonderfully. This will become your go-to breakfast. It's great if you're serving a crowd.

item.title: Mississippi Mash
item.description: These are the ultimate pan-fried potatoes made with very simple ingredients with a delicious result. The onions smell amazing while they're cooking down in bacon drippings. Once the sliced potatoes are added, they begin to absorb the smoky flavor. The potatoes get wonderful crispy bits while frying. Seasoned perfectly, they could replace hash browns as a side dish for breakfast or lunch. Versatile, they'd be tasty with grilled steak too.
